result.topic_en: Series expansion for a geodesic triangle on a curved surface with variable curvature f = F + F'r + F''rr + ..., deriving log(b sin C / c sin B) in terms of the curvatures α, β (written as a script b), γ at the vertices (Gauss's theorem on geodesic triangles).
result.transcription:
r. Man hat dann
$\partial r = \partial t.\cos\zeta$ , $\varrho\partial\theta = \partial t.\sin\zeta$ , $\partial\zeta = -[-\left(\frac{\partial\varrho}{\partial r}\ldots\right)-]\partial\theta = -\left(\frac{\partial\varrho}{\partial r}\right)\partial\theta$
Setzt man $f = F + F'r + F''rr + \text{etc.}$ so wird
$\varrho = r \;.\; -\frac{1}{6}Fr^3 - \frac{1}{12}F'r^4 - \left(\frac{1}{20}F'' - \frac{1}{120}FF\right)r^5 - \left(\frac{1}{30}F''' - \frac{1}{180}FF'\right)r^6\ldots$
$\varrho = r \;.\; -\frac{1}{12}(F+f)r^3 \;.\; +\left(\frac{1}{30}F'' + \frac{1}{120}FF\right)r^5 + \left(\frac{1}{20}F''' + \frac{1}{110}[?]FF'\right)r^6\ldots$
$\partial\log\sin\zeta = -\left(\left(\frac{\partial\varrho}{\partial r}\right)\frac{\partial r}{\varrho}\right).[-\frac{\partial r}{\varrho}-]$
$= -\frac{\partial r}{r} + r\partial r\left\{\frac{1}{3}F + \frac{1}{4}F'r + \left(\frac{1}{5}F'' + \frac{1}{45}FF\right)rr + \left(\frac{1}{6}F''' + \frac{1}{36}FF'\right)r^3\ldots\right.$
$\partial\log r\sin\zeta = \frac{1}{12}(F+3f)r\partial r \quad -\left(\frac{1}{20}F'' - \frac{1}{45}FF\right)r^3\partial r - \left(\frac{1}{12}F''' - \frac{1}{36}FF'\right)r^4\partial r\ldots$
Man hat nun für $\theta = 0$, $\zeta = 180 - B$, $r = c$, $f = \mathfrak{b}$, $F = \alpha$, $t = 0$
$\theta = A$, $\zeta = C$ , $r = b$, $f = \gamma$ $\quad t = a$
allgemein $\quad rr = cc + tt - 2tc.\cos B$
$f = \mathfrak{b} + \frac{t(\gamma-\mathfrak{b})}{a}$
$\log\frac{b\sin C}{c\sin B} = \frac{1}{24}\alpha(bb-cc) + \frac{1}{8}\mathfrak{b}(bb-cc) + \frac{1}{4}(\gamma-\mathfrak{b})\int\frac{tt - tc\cos B}{a}dt$
$= \frac{1}{24}\alpha(bb-cc) + \frac{1}{8}\mathfrak{b}(bb-cc) + \frac{1}{24}(\gamma-\mathfrak{b})(2aa - 3ac\cos B)$
$= \frac{1}{24}\alpha(bb-cc) + \frac{1}{8}\mathfrak{b}(bb-cc) + \frac{1}{48}(\gamma-\mathfrak{b})(aa + 3bb - 3cc)$
$= \frac{1}{24}\alpha(bb-cc) + \frac{1}{48}\mathfrak{b}(-aa + 3bb - 3cc) + \frac{1}{48}\gamma(aa + 3bb - 3cc)$ W.Z.B.W.
It.
